title: LockBit 3.0 Ransomware Operations and Indicators
content:
LockBit 3.0 operators deploy Cobalt Strike beacons to establish persistent command-and-control communication.

The primary C2 infrastructure is hosted on IP address 198.51.100.24 communicating via ATT&CK technique T1071.001.

The threat group exploits CVE-2023-38831 for archive execution and drops the binary payload with hash e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855 from domain malware-drop.xyz.

title: Internal Domain Controller Credential Compromise Response
content:
When abnormal logon events and privilege escalation (technique T1078) occur on domain controller DC-PROD-01 involving service account SVC_SQL_BACKUP:

1. Immediately revoke Active Directory Kerberos tickets.
2. Isolate internal workstation WS-10-45 at IP 10.0.0.45.
3. Reset credentials for compromised administrator analyst.smith@cybercorp.internal.

title: OAuth Consent Phishing Remediation Guide
content:
Threat actors conduct credential harvesting using spoofed OAuth enterprise applications (technique T1566.002 and T1528) hosted on auth-verify-corp.xyz.

Remediation workflow:
- Revoke illicit enterprise application permissions in Microsoft Entra.
- Invalidate all active session tokens and enforce immediate MFA re-registration.
